Reason for Mistake: The agent failed to retrieve accurate information regarding the height of the White House. While the landmark identification in Step 1 was correct, the search query in Step 2 ("height of the White House in feet") returned an incorrect value (70 feet) based on the simulated results. The actual height of the White House is approximately 78 feet (27 meters), not 70 feet. This factual error in data retrieval led to an incorrect final calculation (23 yards instead of the correct ~26 yards). This aligns with the error pattern of relying on inaccurate or incomplete search results without cross-verifying with authoritative sources or recognizing the discrepancy.
